verdictAmendment.reason: The driver also requires the agent's final reply to name check_consistency (agentNamesTool). As in PUZZLE-02, that cannot be observed: the envelope keeps only the final message, which answers the prompt's second half (the returned status). Plan section 4 and section 5 criteria all hold: the server lists all 12 tools including check_file and check_diff, every connection ran with --confine, the agent called check_consistency once (not-applicable on the skeleton-only cell), status completed with 0 permission denials, model claude-sonnet-5-5. No extra call was made.
